“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
verseText: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

templateText: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verseText: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

templateText: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
verseText: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

templateText: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
verseText: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.

templateText: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
verseText: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

templateText: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
verseText: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

templateText: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
verseText: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

templateText: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
verseText: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

templateText: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
verseText: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

templateText: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
verseText: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

templateText: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.
verseText: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

templateText: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
verseText: Cast your burden on Yahweh and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

templateText: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
verseText: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

templateText: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verseText: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

templateText: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
verseText: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

templateText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
verseText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

templateText: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
verseText: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

templateText: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
verseText: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

templateText: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verseText: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

templateText: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
verseText: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

templateText: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.
verseText: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

templateText: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
verseText: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

templateText: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
verseText: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

templateText: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
verseText: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

templateText: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
verseText: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

templateText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verseText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

templateText: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
verseText: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

templateText: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
verseText: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

templateText: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
verseText: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

templateText: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
verseText: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

templateText: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
verseText: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

templateText: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
verseText: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

templateText: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
verseText: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

templateText: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
verseText: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

templateText: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
verseText: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

templateText: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
verseText: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

templateText: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
verseText: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

templateText: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
verseText: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

templateText: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”
verseText: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

templateText: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
verseText: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

templateText: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
verseText: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

templateText: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
verseText: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

templateText: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
verseText: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

templateText: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
verseText: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

templateText: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
verseText: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

templateText: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
verseText: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

templateText: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”
verseText: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

templateText: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
verseText: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

templateText: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.
verseText: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

templateText: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verseText: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

templateText: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.
verseText: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

templateText: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
verseText: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

templateText: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
verseText: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

templateText: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
verseText: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

templateText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
verseText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

templateText: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
verseText: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

templateText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
verseText: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

templateText: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
verseText: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

templateText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
verseText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

templateText: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
verseText: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

templateText: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
verseText: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

templateText: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
verseText: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

templateText: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
verseText: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

templateText: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
verseText: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

templateText: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.
verseText: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

templateText: Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
verseText: Always rejoice. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

templateText: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
verseText: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

templateText: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,
verseText: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

templateText: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
verseText: Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

templateText: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
verseText: but those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

templateText: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
verseText: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

templateText: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
verseText: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.

templateText: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.
verseText: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.

templateText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
verseText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

templateText: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
verseText: ‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

templateText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
verseText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

templateText: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
verseText: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

templateText: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
verseText: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

templateText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
verseText: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

templateText: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
verseText: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

እግዚአብሔር ጉዞው ቀልጣፋ ይሆን አልተናገረም፣ ነገር ግን እሱ ከእኛ ጋር እንደማይለይ አለ። — ያልታወቀ
ጸሎት መጠየቅ አይደለም። የነፍስ ምኞት ነው። — ማሃትማ ጋንዲ
እምነትህ ከፍርሀትህ ይበልጥ። — ያልታወቀ
እግዚአብሔር በእኛ ውስጥ በጣም የተከበረ ነው በእርሱ ውስጥ በጣም የተጠገነን ጊዜ። — ጆን ፓይፐር
እግዚአብሔር እንደገና ሊያደርግህ ለማይችል በጣም ዝቅ አይደለም። — ያልታወቀ
የእግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ የጸጋው ማይጠብቅህበት ቦታ አይደርስህም። — ያልታወቀ
ዕድል የጸሎት የተነጋገረ ፍርሃት ነው። — ዶሮቲ በርናርድ
ጸሎትህን በቃላት ማሳየት አልቻልክም በሚል ጊዜ፣ እግዚአብሔር ልብህን ይሰማል። — ያልታወቀ
እግዚአብሔር በእሁድ ብቻ የሚኖር አይደለም። ዕለታዊ እውነት ነው። — ያልታወቀ
ጸጋ ማለት ሁሉም ስህተቶችህ አሁን ዓላማ እንዲያገለግሉ ማለት ነው። — ያልታወቀ
ሌሊቱ እንደሚደበር ከዚያ ብርሃኑ ይበራል። — ፊዮዶር ዶስቶይፍስኪ
በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የሚደክም ማንኛውንም ሰው ፊት ሊቆም ይችላል። — ያልታወቀ
ሐሜት የነገ ሐዘን አያስወግድም፤ ዛሬን ግን ኃይል ያስወግዳል። — ኮሪ ተን ቡም
አመስግናለሁ የሚለው ልብ ለተአምር መጥረጊያ ነው። — ያልታወቀ
እግዚአብሔር የሚመራበት ቦታ ይሰጣል። — ያልታወቀ
የሚሻለው ገና ይመጣል። እግዚአብሔር ከአንተ ጋር አልተጨረሰም። — ያልታወቀ
ደስታ ከሚያጋጥምህ ነገር አይመጣም፣ ነገር ግን በአንተ ይመጣል። — ያልታወቀ
በችግር መካከል እድል ይገኛል። — አልበርት አይንስታይን

{name}, መክፈል ድካም አይደለም፤ ከሚበረታ እጅ መታመን ነው። — ያልታወቀ

“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”
verseText: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

templateText: መጨረሻ ምን ጊዜ ሳይሆን ማንኛውንም ማያ ሳይመለከት አንድ ሰዓት ያህል ወሰድክ? በዙሪያህ ያለውን ዓለም ምን አስተዋልክ?
But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.
verseText: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

templateText: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
verseText: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

templateText: "ማንኛውም ነገር ለጥቂት ደቂቃዎች ከእርሱ ተለይቶ ይሰራል፣ እንደ አንተም ይሆናል።" — አን ላሞት
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
verseText: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

templateText: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
verseText: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

templateText: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”
verseText: But Yahweh said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the outward appearance, but Yahweh looks at the heart.”

templateText: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,
verseText: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

templateText: እንደ ምን ይሆን ዛሬ ለአንድ ነገር እግዚአብሔርን በሰውነትህ ማድረግ ማመስገን ከምን ይሆን እንደሚታይ ማቅረብ ይህን ከማስተካከል ይልቅ?
አንተ ስህተት አይደለህም። ለመፍታት ያለ ችግር አይደለህም። ነገር ግን እራስህን በነካህ ቅጥር ላይ ማምታትን ማቆም እስኪፈቅድህ ድረስ ይህን አታግኝም።" — ጂኒን ሮዝ
You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.
verseText: You are all beautiful, my love. There is no spot in you.

templateText: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship; and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
verseText: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship; and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

templateText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
verseText: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

templateText: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,
verseText: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship,

templateText: እንደማይታወቅ የምታስብ ፈጠራዊ ሕልም ምን ነበር? እንዲህ ሕልም በአስተዋይነት በአንተ ውስጥ የተተከለ እንደሆነ ምን አለ?
"የፈጠራ ጠላት ዋነኛ የማስተዋል ነው።" — ፓብሎ ፒካሶ
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verseText: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

templateText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
verseText: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

templateText: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”
verseText: Yahweh’s angel came again the second time, and touched him, and said, “Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you.”

templateText: ሙያዊ እርዳታ መፈለግ እምነት እንደሌለዎት አይደለም፤ ጥበብ ነው። እግዚአብሔር በሐኪሞች፣ አማካሪዎች፣ እና ማህበረሰብ ይፈውሳል። ለርዳታ መጠየቅ ፍቃድ ሰጥተዋልን?
“ጸጋ ማለት ሁሉም ስህተቶችዎ አሁን አንድ ዓላማ እንዲያገለግሉ ማለት ነው እንጂ እንደ ነዋሪ አይገለግሉም።” — ብሬኔ ብራውን
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
verseText: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

templateText: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
verseText: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

templateText: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
verseText: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

templateText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
verseText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

templateText: ዛሬ ለምን ይህ በጣም የሚያጋጥምህ ነው? በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስሙን ጥራ — የተጠራ ይታገላል።
"መመለስ ለሚያስፈልገው ሰው አይደለም። ለሚፈልገው ሰው ነው።" — አስተማማኝ
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
verseText: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

templateText: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verseText: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

templateText: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
verseText: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.

templateText: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.
verseText: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

templateText: መንፈሳዊ መሪ ወይም ማህበረሰብ ማስተማር ያስፈልግሃል — የሆነውን ለመስረዳት ሳይሆን ከመሸከም ለመነጻት ነው?
"ክርስቲያን መሆን ማለት የማይታወቅ ይቅር ማለት ነው፣ ምክንያቱም እግዚአብሔር የማይታወቅ ይቅር አለኝ።" — ሲ.ኤስ. ሉዊስ
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.
verseText: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

templateText: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
verseText: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.

templateText: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me. He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
verseText: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me. He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

templateText: በተደጋጋሚ ሕመም ላይ በመተማመን ሌላ መንገድ ሊማርህ የማይችል ምን ነገር እንደማይችል ምን አስተማረህ?
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
verseText: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

templateText: "እግዚአብሔር መከራን አያነሣም፣ እንዲሁም ከአላማ ውጭ አይቅጣም። የሚያርስ ከሆነ፣ የሚያጭድ ነገር አለው።" — ጄ.አይ. ፓከር
Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.
verseText: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

templateText: and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.
verseText: and Yahweh will guide you continually, satisfy your soul in dry places, and make your bones strong. You will be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water whose waters don’t fail.

templateText: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
verseText: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

templateText: ሌላውን እንደምታንከባከብ ራስህን መጠንከር መጨረሻ መቼ ነበር? ዛሬ ማግኘት እንጂ መስጠት ብቻ ምን ይመስላል?
"ከባድ ዕቃ ከባድ ዕቃ አይወስድም። አስቀድሞ ራስህን እንከባከብ።" — ኤልኖር ብራውን
Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.
verseText: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

templateText: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
verseText: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

templateText: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
verseText: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

templateText: በዚህ ወቅት በግንኙነት ውስጥ ብትሆን የማትችል ምን ማድረግ ትችላለህ? እግዚአብሔር ይህን ወቅት ለማስተማርህ እንዴት ሊጠቀም ይችላል?
"ብቸኝነት የተለየ የእንክብካቤ አልባ አይደለም፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቅርብ መኖር አልባ ነው።" — ኤ.ደብረ ቶዘር
For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.
verseText: For your Maker is your husband; Yahweh of Armies is his name. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer. He will be called the God of the whole earth.

templateText: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verseText: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

templateText: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
verseText: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

templateText: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
verseText: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

templateText: የእንደነበረውን ማንነትህ ክፍል ከጋብቻህ ጋር የተያያዘ ነበር እንደሚሆን እግዚአብሔር እንደሚያስቀምጥ ይገኝ?
"እግዚአብሔር የተሰበረውን ማስተካከል እና ወደ ታላቅ ነገር ለመለወጥ ይችላል።" — ኢዮኤል 2:25
And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,
verseText: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

templateText: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.
verseText: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

templateText: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.
verseText: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

templateText: በሥራ ቦታ ውስጥ ምን እንደሚገባውን እንደምታውቅ ነገር አለ ነገር ግን እስካሁን አላደረግኸውም? ምን እንደሚያቆምህ?
“የተገባ ነገር ማድረግ የተገባ ጊዜ ሁሌም ነው።” — ማርቲን ሉተር ኪንግ ጁኒየር
Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
verseText: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

templateText: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.
verseText: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

templateText: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury, for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”
verseText: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury, for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

templateText: ምንንም ማስገኛ የሚያስበረታህ እንጂ የሚያስቀንስህ ያለ ጊዜ መቼ ነበር?
“በመስጠት ማንም ድሀ አልሆነም።” — አን ፍራንክ
“Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verseText: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

templateText: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
verseText: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

templateText: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God. For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
verseText: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God. For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

templateText: በዚህ ሳምንት የእውነተኛ ሰንበት ምን ይመስልልዎታል? ሥራን ብቻ ማስወገድ ሳይሆን በዕረፍት ላይ በደስታ መደሰት ነውን?
“ዕረፍት ቀን ካላመረጡ ሥጋችሁ ለእርስዎ ይመርጣል።” — ያልታወቀ
For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.
verseText: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

templateText: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
verseText: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.

templateText: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.
verseText: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

templateText: ከማህበራዊ ሚዲያ 30 ደቂቃ በኋላ እንዴት ትሰማላችሁ? ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይዛችላችሁ ወይስ ይርቃችላችሁ?
"ከሌሎች የተለያዩ የሚታዩ እና የሚሰማዩ ነገሮችን ከእርስዎ የተለያዩ የተሰወሩ ነገሮች አትነጻጸሩ።" — ስቲቨን ፈርቲክ
For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
verseText: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

templateText: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.
verseText: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

templateText: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”
verseText: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for who is able to judge this great people of yours?”

templateText: እርስዎ ዋጋችሁን ለማረጋገጥ ወይም እግዚአብሔር የሰጠዎትን አእምሮ ለማስተዳደር ትማሩን? መልሱ ሁሉንም ይለዋውጣል።
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
verseText: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

templateText: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
verseText: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

templateText: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
verseText: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

templateText: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”
verseText: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”

templateText: እግዚአብሔር የተወለድኸው ልጁ ሆነህ ማለት ምን ያህል ያስተምርሃል? ቤተሰብን እንዴት እንደምታይ እንዴት ይቀይራል?
God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
verseText: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

templateText: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
verseText: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

templateText: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
verseText: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

templateText: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”
verseText: Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.”

templateText: አገልግለህ ወይም አገልግለህ ከነበር ምን ዓይነት ከባድ ጭነት እስካሁን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ሳይጥል ትሸከማለህ? እርሱ ማንነቱን ይችላል።
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
verseText: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

templateText: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
verseText: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

templateText: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.
verseText: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God.

templateText: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God. Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”
verseText: Ruth said, “Don’t urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God. Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May Yahweh do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.”

templateText: በዚህ ሳምንት የአማልክት ልጅ ወይም አዲስ የቤተሰብ አባል በእውነት የተወደደና የታየ እንዲሆን የምትወስደው አንድ ትንሽ እርምጃ ምንድን ነው?
See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
verseText: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

templateText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.
verseText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

templateText: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
verseText: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

templateText: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
verseText: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

templateText: ገንዘብ እና ፍርሃት አልነበሩም ብለው በሕይወትዎ ምን ታደርጋላችሁ? ያ ምኞት የእግዚአብሔር ዝም ማለት ሊሆን ይችላል።
“እግዚአብሔር ወደሚጠራዎት ቦታ የሚደስታችሁ እና የዓለም ጥልቅ ምርኮን የሚገናኝበት ቦታ ነው።” — ፍሬድሪክ ቢክነር
Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
verseText: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

templateText: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
verseText: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

templateText: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
verseText: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.

templateText: በሕይወትዎ ውስጥ እውነተኛውን እርስዎን የሚያውቅ ማነው? የተሻለውን እንጂ የተጠራውን እንደሆነ አንድ ሰው አለ? ከሌለ አንድ ሰው ለማስቀመጥ አንድ እርምጃ ምንድን ነው?
“ወዳጅነት አንድ ሰው ለሌላው ሲላም እንዲህ ሲል የሚወለድ ነው፤ ‘ምን! አንተም? እኔ ብቻዬን እንደሆንኩ አስቤ ነበር።’” — ሲ.ኤስ. ሉዊስ
They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,
verseText: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

templateText: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
verseText: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

templateText: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”
verseText: Now therefore give me this hill country, of which Yahweh spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and great and fortified cities. It may be that Yahweh will be with me, and I shall drive them out, as Yahweh said.”

templateText: ለሚቀጥለው ትውልድ እጅግ የሚያስፈልገው ምን ያህል ጥበብ ትሸከማለህ? በዚህ ሳምንት ማንን ማስተላለፍ ትችላለህ?
"የጐበዝ ሰው ክብር ኃይሉ ነው፣ የሽምግልና ግራም ጠጕር ክብር ነው።" — መጽሐፈ ምሳሌ 20:29
You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?
verseText: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

templateText: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says Yahweh.
verseText: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says Yahweh.

templateText: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.
verseText: I prayed for this child, and Yahweh has given me my petition which I asked of him.

templateText: አሁን በሕይወትህ ውስጥ ፍሬ ማፍራት እንዴት ይመስልሃል፣ ከወላጅነት ውጭ እንኳ?
For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.
verseText: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it, because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

templateText: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
verseText: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

templateText: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
verseText: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

templateText: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
verseText: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

templateText: ለእንቅልፍ ጊዜ የለም። ለቅርብ ወዳጅህ በዚህ ጊዜ የምታደርገውን ያህል ራስህን ቸርነት ስጥ።
I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
verseText: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

templateText: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.
verseText: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

templateText: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?
verseText: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?

templateText: እንዴት እንደሚችሉ ሰዎች የማይችሉ እይታ ወይም ኃይል እንዴት እንደተለወጠ እንደምታስተዋውቅ?
Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
verseText: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

templateText: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.
verseText: The earth is Yahweh’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

templateText: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”
verseText: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

templateText: በእግዚአብሔር የተሰጠን ዓለም የተሻለ እንዲሆን በዚህ ሳምንት ምን ልማድ ማለወጥ ትችላለህ?
For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,
verseText: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

templateText: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
verseText: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

templateText: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
verseText: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

templateText: በሁለት ባህል መካከል መኖር ሌላ በማንነት እንደማታማር ምን ያህል ስለ እግዚአብሔር አስተምሯል?
The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
verseText: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

templateText: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.
verseText: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

templateText: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.
verseText: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

verseText: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

verseText: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

templateText: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

templateText: "እግዚአብሔር እንደ አንድ ሰው ብቻ እንደሆነ እያንዳንዱን ይወዳል።" — አውጐስቲኖስ የሂፖ
"ጸሎት አድርግ፣ እና እግዚአብሔር ይጨነቅ ዘንድ ተው።" — ማርቲን ሉተር
